verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Skills can be built against official SDKs and APIs. The Claude Agent SDK (Python and TypeScript) lets developers control which skills sessions can invoke, author skills the sessions discover, and programmatically load plugins and Claude Code features. The Messages API takes skills through the `container` parameter, and a Skills API with version management handles upload and management. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs; the evidence is entirely vendor documentation.
